effect_description_eng:
[Security] Play this card without paying the cost.
[Start of Your Main Phase] By placing 1 [Kurata's Army] trait card from your hand face down under this Tamer, ＜Draw 1＞ (Draw 1 card from your deck.) and gain 1 memory.
[Main] [Once Per Turn] By trashing 2 bottom face-down cards from under any of your Tamers, this Tamer may digivolve into a [Kurata's Army] trait Digimon card in the hand or trash with the cost reduced by 2.
inherited_effect_description_eng: [End of Attack] [Once Per Turn] By choosing 1 of your Digimon, delete it and 1 of your opponent's Digimon with as much DP as this Digimon or less.
